title: VAT and billing details on bills
problem: Subscription bills had no VAT line and a store's BIN, invoice name and billing email could not be kept.
now: New bills carry 15% VAT and the store's billing name, BIN and email; staff or the owner can change those details.
steps: Open a bill issued in the last few days: it has a VAT 15% line
Its Facts show who it is billed to; Print shows both BINs
On a merchant profile press Edit on Billing details and save a BIN
The next bill keeps the new details
notes: Where: Super admin: Billing & credits › Invoices › a bill; merchant profile › Billing details · Merchant: Settings › Business verification · Needs the server: Bills issued before the rule started keep no VAT line.

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('.mn-x'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } })()
